site.name: Arty-Snow Adit / Upper Wilkes-Barre Workings
site.location: St. Kevin mining district, Lake County
site.componentType: Upper adit / portal and associated workings
site.componentDetail: Upper Arty-Snow adit and associated upper Wilkes-Barre workings on the Arty/Snow vein; distinct from the lower Wilkesbarre adit.
overview: The Arty-Snow Adit is an upper Wilkes-Barre working in the St. Kevin mining district, historically associated with the Arty and Snow vein. The identification point represents the documented historic working and is not a visitor access point.

timeline.text: USGS reporting states that the Arty and Snow vein was located in 1884.
USGS reporting attributes about $15,000 in gross production from work at the upper adit during this period, chiefly silver.

moreHistory: Historic production reporting for the Wilkes-Barre group can combine multiple workings, so broader group totals should not be treated as specific to this adit.
Colorado Geological Survey reporting places the upper workings on patented private claims; the site is presented for identification and historical context, not as an access recommendation.

sourceReferences.title: Open-File Report 01-14
sourceReferences.note: Supports the Wilkesbarre Group identity, claim relationships, and private patented-claim context.

sourceReferences.title: USGS Bulletin 1027-E, Sugar Loaf and St. Kevin Mining Districts
sourceReferences.note: Supports the Arty and Snow vein history and upper-adit production context.
